name: Tablets and e-readers

comps.spec: 3.7–3.8V lithium pouch pack, 3,000–11,000 mAh — glued in; never pry with metal
comps.loc: Behind the screen, filling most of the back

comps.spec: Touchscreen LCD or OLED, 7–13 in; e-readers use a paper-like e-ink screen
LED backlight strip (LCD models) or front light (e-readers)
Light-guide plate and diffuser sheets (LCD models)
Rows of small neodymium bars for covers and pens (cover-compatible models)
comps.loc: Along the edges inside the case

comps.spec: Hall sensor that wakes it when the cover opens

boards.loc: Protection board on the battery pack

notes: E-readers run for weeks on one charge and hold thousands of books: load them with repair manuals and medical references while you still can. Cellular tablets also have a GPS receiver; most Wi-Fi-only ones do not.

sources.title: Weight: tablets averaged 0.58 kg, e-readers 0.32 kg (Babbitt et al. 2020, disassembly-based bill of materials data for consumer electronics, CC0)
Open Repair Alliance, Open Repair Data v0.3 (community repair events, 2012 to July 2026; CC BY-SA 4.0): 4,689 repairs recorded as Tablet
